modifier.nebula_tinker.abuser.descriptio: Melee hits against poisoned, withered, or bleeding targets are critical hits.
modifier.nebula_tinker.clockwork.descrip: With Speed, melee attacks gain 5 percentage points of critical chance and an additional 10% of base damage on critical hits per Speed level.
modifier.nebula_tinker.shadow.descriptio: Hits deal 2 points of additional void damage at level I, plus 1 per further level.
